scheme_name: INSPIRE Awards – MANAK (Million Minds Augmenting National Aspirations and Knowledge)
description:
The INSPIRE Awards – MANAK scheme was launched by the Government of India on December 27, 2018. 

This initiative is part of the broader INSPIRE (Innovation in Science Pursuit for Inspired Research) program. 

The primary objective of the INSPIRE Awards – MANAK scheme is to foster a culture of innovation among school students. 

It aims to encourage students from classes 6 to 10 to develop scientific temper and creativity. 

The scheme targets the enhancement of the scientific mindset among young minds. 

The program is designed to identify and nurture innovative ideas from students across the country. 

The specific goal is to select one million students annually who will receive awards for their innovative projects. 

The initiative also aims to promote the importance of science and technology in everyday life. 

Students are encouraged to submit their innovative ideas and projects through a structured process. 

The awards are intended to motivate students to pursue careers in science and technology fields. 

The INSPIRE Awards – MANAK scheme provides financial assistance to students for their projects. 

Each selected student receives a cash award of INR 10,000. 

In addition to the cash award, students also receive a certificate of recognition. 

The scheme also facilitates mentorship and guidance for the students in their project development. 

The eligibility criteria for the INSPIRE Awards – MANAK scheme are specific. 

Students must be enrolled in classes 6 to 10 in recognized schools across India. 

There are no income criteria or educational qualifications required for the students. 

The application process for the INSPIRE Awards – MANAK scheme is straightforward. 

Students must submit their innovative project ideas through the official website. 

The submission must include a detailed description of the project and its objectives. 

Students are also required to provide information about the methodology used in their projects. 

The application must be endorsed by the school authorities. 

The deadline for project submission is usually set for the end of the academic year. 

The awards are announced in a ceremony held annually. 

The INSPIRE Awards – MANAK scheme is implemented by the Department of Science and Technology. 

The implementing agency is the National Innovation Foundation of India. 

The contact details for the National Innovation Foundation can be found on their official website. 

The scheme has seen significant participation since its inception. 

In the first year alone, over 1.5 million students submitted their project ideas. 

The selection process involves a rigorous evaluation of the submitted projects. 

Projects are assessed based on their originality, feasibility, and potential impact. 

A panel of experts from various fields evaluates the submissions. 

The selected projects are then showcased at the national level. 

The INSPIRE Awards – MANAK scheme also includes a mentorship component. 

Selected students receive guidance from experienced mentors in their respective fields. 

This mentorship helps students refine their projects and enhance their skills. 

The scheme also promotes collaboration among students from different regions. 

Students are encouraged to work in teams to foster teamwork and collaborative learning. 

The initiative has been instrumental in promoting STEM education in India. 

It aligns with the government's vision of a knowledge-based economy. 

The INSPIRE Awards – MANAK scheme also contributes to the Atmanirbhar Bharat initiative. 

It empowers students to think innovatively and contribute to national development. 

The scheme has received positive feedback from educators and students alike. 

Many schools have integrated the INSPIRE Awards into their curriculum. 

The initiative has also led to the establishment of science clubs in various schools. 

These clubs provide a platform for students to explore scientific concepts further. 

The INSPIRE Awards – MANAK scheme has been recognized for its impact on youth innovation. 

It has inspired students to pursue research and development activities. 

The scheme also emphasizes the importance of practical learning experiences. 

Students are encouraged to conduct experiments and engage in hands-on activities. 

The awards serve as a motivation for students to excel in their studies. 

The initiative has also led to increased interest in science fairs and exhibitions. 

Schools often organize events to showcase student projects related to the INSPIRE Awards. 

The INSPIRE Awards – MANAK scheme has a significant outreach program. 

Workshops and seminars are conducted to educate students about the application process. 

These events help demystify the concept of innovation for young minds. 

The scheme has also been promoted through various social media platforms. 

This outreach has resulted in increased awareness and participation. 

The government aims to expand the scope of the INSPIRE Awards in the coming years. 

Future plans include increasing the award amount and expanding eligibility criteria. 

The INSPIRE Awards – MANAK scheme is an essential part of India's educational landscape. 

It plays a crucial role in shaping the future of science and technology in the country. 

The initiative reflects the government's commitment to nurturing young talent. 

The scheme continues to evolve to meet the changing needs of students. 

Overall, the INSPIRE Awards – MANAK scheme is a significant step towards fostering innovation. 

It empowers students to think critically and creatively. 

The initiative is a testament to India's focus on building a robust scientific community. 

Through this scheme, the government aims to create a generation of innovators. 

The INSPIRE Awards – MANAK scheme is a beacon of hope for aspiring young scientists. 

It encourages them to dream big and work towards realizing their aspirations. 

The scheme is a vital investment in the future of India's scientific and technological advancement.
